title: Casablanca
synopsis: In wartime Morocco, a cynical nightclub owner must choose between love and virtue when his former flame and her resistance-leader husband walk into his café.

title: Metropolis
synopsis: In a towering futuristic city, the son of a powerful industrialist discovers the underground world of laborers and joins a prophetic struggle for solidarity.

title: Nosferatu
synopsis: A real-estate clerk travels to Transylvania and unwittingly invites a vampire plague into his quiet coastal town.

title: The Cabinet of Dr. Caligari
synopsis: A mysterious hypnotist and his somnambulist sideshow act may be connected to a series of murders in a twisted expressionist nightmare.

title: Night of the Living Dead
synopsis: Strangers barricade themselves in a rural farmhouse as the recently dead rise and hunger for the living.

title: Plan 9 from Outer Space
synopsis: Aliens resurrect the dead to stop humanity from inventing a doomsday weapon, in one of cinema’s most infamous cult adventures.

title: His Girl Friday
synopsis: A scheming newspaper editor races the clock to win back his ex-wife reporter before she leaves town—and the scoop of a lifetime.

title: Charade
synopsis: A widow in Paris is swept into a stylish chase involving stolen money, impostors, and a charming stranger who may not be who he seems.
